newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Rogers Communications sells notes.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Rogers Communications sells notes.

text.p: The following two-tranche debt issue from Rogers Communications Inc was priced Thursday, according to lead managers Merrill Lynch & Co Inc and Scotia McLeod, respectively.
The US$330 million offer was increased in size from an original US$250 million. The C$165 million was increased in size from an original C$150 million.
